This should go into 2024.6


This PR fixes a long-standing issue with the Jewish calendar integration.
The current unique ID implementation uses the configuration settings of the integration with some configuration of Home Assistant (location and altitude). If the user changed the location or some of the relevant settings in the config, all the sensors would become unavailable.

issue_context.title: The Jewish Calendar component seems to have stopped working
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hey!

I use the [Jewish Calendar integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/jewish_calendar/) to get updated about times for Jewish religious observance. 

I created a dashboard for it recently and noticed that a few days ago some of the sensors started showing an unavailable status:

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/40233203/8e7e78f4-7101-46ba-bc46-c76a1492fe31)

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/40233203/66c343cd-9ccf-4a9c-885d-483d512f116e)

Just flagging here as I have a feeling the entities weren't removed intentionally.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.3.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Jewish Calendar 

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/jewish_calendar/

review_comments: So if I understand correctly, we can only have 1 entry and in the forseeable future we will only support one. If that is indeed the case, we could just migrate this to be `description.key`. But if there even is a slight change we will support more instances, we should prefix this indeed

Exactly. When I started, I thought about a use case for multiple instances, like having the weather forecast for various locations. But it's an edge case. So for the moment, I want to keep it this way.
Sorry for being a bit picky but could we do `any(entry.unique_id.startswith(old_prefix) for entry in entries` also here to ensure all entities are migrated so there isn't any discrepancy anywhere?
